description: Creates a rollout in the pending state without shifting traffic. Start the rollout in a separate request after reviewing its strategy and metric gates.

canary.summary: Canary rollout with a metric gate

DE.CreateRolloutRequest.description: Strategy, metric gates, timing, and cleanup policy for shifting traffic between two deployments under one endpoint.

blueGreen.description: Blue-green rollout strategy configuration. Mutually exclusive with canary and rolling.

canary.description: Canary rollout strategy configuration. Mutually exclusive with blueGreen and rolling.

finalSourceReplicas.description: Optional final replica count for the source deployment. Defaults to 0, which drains and stops the source.

finalTargetReplicas.description: Optional target replica floor at completion. Must be at least 1 when set; defaults to the source deployment's replica count at create time, or to the source and target deployments' combined replica count when both already stand in the endpoint traffic split after a cancel. If this exceeds the target autoscaling max, the rollout raises that max once when first needed unless an operator changes max mid-run; the raised ceiling remains after completion. If the target's autoscaling min, or the source min inherited by a target that starts stopped, is higher, completion holds that higher floor and PreviewRolloutDefaults reports FINAL_BELOW_INHERITED_MIN.

metrics.description: Optional metric gates evaluated after each step's soak. Canary only; rejected on rolling and blue-green rollouts.

rolling.description: Rolling rollout strategy configuration. Mutually exclusive with canary and blueGreen.

sourceDeploymentId.description: Deployment that traffic shifts away from.

DE.Rollout.description: Public view of a rollout resource and its embedded runtime status.

completedAt.description: Output only. Timestamp when the rollout reached a terminal state.

createdAt.description: Output only. Timestamp when the rollout was created.

currentStep.description: Output only. Zero-based index of the current step. Unset while PENDING; step 0 is reported explicitly after start.

currentTrafficPercent.description: Output only. Applied percentage of traffic on the target deployment.

endpointId.description: Output only. Endpoint this rollout belongs to.

etag.description: Output only. Opaque version tag for optimistic concurrency control.

pauseInfo.description: Output only. Why and when the rollout was paused. Set while a pause is pending or effective (PAUSING, PAUSED, or SYSTEM_PAUSED); while PAUSING, pausedAt records when the pause was requested.

sourceDeploymentId.description: Output only. Deployment that traffic is shifting away from.

startedAt.description: Output only. Timestamp when the rollout started running.

state.description: Output only. High-level rollout lifecycle state.

status.description: Output only. Derived runtime progress and failure details.

strategy.description: Output only. Rollout strategy selected at creation.

targetDeploymentId.description: Output only. Deployment that traffic is shifting toward.

DE.BlueGreenConfig.description: Blue-green strategy configuration for a single cutover to the target deployment.

DE.CanaryConfig.description: Canary strategy configuration for gradual traffic progression. An empty config uses the default 5, 25, 50, 100 percent ladder; over a frozen traffic-split pair left by cancel, the default ladder is derived at start from the pair's current served share so it begins above it.

stepInterval.description: Optional positive soak between steps. Defaults to 3m if omitted, and grows to cover metric rule windows plus ingestion lag.

steps.description: Optional progression steps. Defaults to 5, 25, 50, 100 percent when empty; explicit steps must increase and end at 100 percent.

DE.MetricRule.description: Metric gate evaluated during a rollout.

name.description: Required catalogue key for the metric to gate on. `serving_latency` is retired.

percentile.description: Percentile value, such as 99. Set only when stat is METRIC_STAT_TYPE_PERCENTILE.

regressionCheck.description: Regression evaluation criteria. Mutually exclusive with thresholdCheck.

stat.description: Required aggregation used for the metric.

thresholdCheck.description: Threshold evaluation criteria. Mutually exclusive with regressionCheck.

window.description: Optional query window for the metric. Defaults to the step soak duration.

DE.RollingConfig.description: Rolling strategy configuration for capacity-preserving batches that ramp target replicas up while draining source replicas.

DE.PauseInfo.description: Pause metadata returned while a rollout is paused.

pausedAt.description: Timestamp when the rollout was paused.

reason.description: Human-readable reason recorded when the rollout was paused.

DE.RolloutStatus.description: Derived runtime progress for a rollout.

condition.description: Failure detail set when the rollout pauses, system-pauses, or aborts.

conditions.description: Informational conditions that describe the rollout's current state. Omitted when empty; clients should treat an absent key as an empty list.

totalSteps.description: Total number of steps in the rollout progression. Always serializes when status is present.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent progress update.

DE.RolloutStep.description: One stage of a canary rollout progression.

replicas.description: Optional explicit target replica count for this step.

traffic.description: Required percentage of traffic on the target deployment for this step.

DE.RegressionCheck.description: Regression criteria that fail when the target regresses against the source beyond a limit.

direction.description: Required direction that indicates whether higher or lower metric values are worse.

DE.ThresholdCheck.description: Threshold criteria that fail when the target metric violates the configured bound.

operator.description: Required comparison operator applied to the target metric value.

DE.RolloutCondition.description: Structured reason a rollout stopped progressing.

atStep.description: Step index where the condition arose. Step 0 serializes explicitly.

category.description: Category that classifies why the rollout stopped.

metrics.description: Metrics observed at the failing gate, enriched with their criteria.

observedAt.description: Timestamp when the condition was observed.

type.description: Informational condition type. `CapacityLimited` means the current step advanced partially because full capacity was not placeable.

DE.RolloutStepStatus.description: Collapsed execution state for one rollout step.

failureReason.description: Failure reason when this step failed.

metrics.description: Metric gate results for this step.

state.description: Execution state of this rollout step.

stepIndex.description: Index of this step in the rollout progression. Step 0 serializes explicitly.

targetTrafficPercent.description: Target traffic percentage configured for this step. Always serializes for recorded steps.

DE.MetricResult.description: Observed metric value enriched with its rollout rule and verdict.

check.description: Evaluation form used by the metric rule.

direction.description: Direction that indicates whether higher or lower values are worse.

maxRegressionPercent.description: Regression percentage limit used when check is METRIC_CHECK_TYPE_REGRESSION.

name.description: Metric name as exported to the observability backend.

percentile.description: Percentile value, such as 99. Set only when stat is METRIC_STAT_TYPE_PERCENTILE.

sourceValue.description: Observed source baseline. Set only for regression checks; a 0 reading serializes explicitly.

targetValue.description: Observed target value. A 0 reading serializes explicitly.

threshold.description: Threshold criteria used when check is METRIC_CHECK_TYPE_THRESHOLD.

verdict.description: Result of evaluating this metric at the gate.
